settings.intro_text: Lattafa is one of the most loved Arabian fragrance houses in the world, a UAE brand that makes luxurious, long-lasting scent accessible to everyone. Rooted in Arabian heritage, the name comes from the Arabic for kindness and pleasantness. The Fragrance Secrets brings together authentic Lattafa perfumes for men and women, including global bestsellers like Khamrah, Yara, Asad, and Raghba, plus the premium Lattafa Pride line. From spiced gourmands to rich oud and sweet florals, Lattafa delivers designer-level performance at a price that makes discovering new scents easy.

settings.title: A Global Arabian Favourite
settings.body: Founded in the UAE, Lattafa has grown into one of the most recognised Arabian fragrance houses in the world, available across more than a hundred countries and loved for accessible Arabian luxury.

settings.title: Bestselling Signatures
settings.body: Lattafa's fame rests on hits like Khamrah, a spiced date-and-vanilla gourmand, Yara, a creamy sweet floral, and Asad, a bold fruity-leather masculine, alongside oud-rich Raghba and Bade'e Al Oud.

settings.title: A Range for Every Taste
settings.body: From warm gourmands and rich oud to sweet florals and fresh modern blends, Lattafa spans distinct fragrance families, plus the premium Lattafa Pride tier with more complex, higher-grade compositions.

settings.title: Luxury Made Accessible
settings.body: Made in full eau de parfum strength, Lattafa fragrances are known for strong projection and long wear that rivals far pricier scents, offering genuine Arabian luxury at an accessible price.

settings.question: Is Lattafa a good perfume brand?
settings.answer: Yes. Lattafa is a well-established UAE Arabian house loved worldwide for long-lasting, high-quality fragrances at an accessible price. Bestsellers like Khamrah and Yara have made it a global favourite.

settings.question: What is Lattafa's most popular perfume?
settings.answer: Some of Lattafa's most popular scents are Khamrah, a spiced gourmand, Yara, a sweet creamy floral, and Asad, a bold masculine. Raghba and Bade'e Al Oud are also widely loved.

settings.question: Where are Lattafa perfumes made?
settings.answer: Lattafa is a UAE-based Arabian fragrance house. It draws on Middle Eastern perfumery traditions, blending oud, amber, and spice with modern gourmand and floral styles for a global audience.

settings.question: Do Lattafa perfumes last long?
settings.answer: Yes. Made in full eau de parfum concentration, Lattafa fragrances are known for strong projection and long wear that often rivals far pricier designer scents, performing well in warm climates.

settings.question: Are Lattafa perfumes authentic at The Fragrance Secrets?
settings.answer: Yes. Every Lattafa perfume at The Fragrance Secrets is 100% authentic and sourced through trusted suppliers, sealed and quality-checked, so you can shop with complete confidence.

settings.question: Do you ship Lattafa perfumes internationally?
settings.answer: Yes. The Fragrance Secrets delivers Lattafa perfumes across the UAE and also ships to customers in the USA and Canada. Shipping options and delivery estimates are available during checkout.
